# Raw pipeline data (not included — regenerated by preprocessing steps 01-05)

**Not included** in this repository: these are large intermediate files produced by the very
first preprocessing steps (raw genome downloads and per-genome QC annotation), before any
filtering. They are not hosted externally either — regenerate them by running the pipeline
below, since they're cheap to reproduce from public NCBI/Nextclade sources (unlike the
downstream trajectory/model artifacts, which take much longer to regenerate and *are*
earmarked for Zenodo — see `data/trajectories/README.md` and `models/README.md`).

Expected contents, by subdirectory:

| Path | Written by | Read by |
|---|---|---|
| `ncbi_virus/ncbi_all.zip`, `ncbi_virus/all/` (unzipped NCBI Datasets package) | `cluster/slurm/preprocessing/01_download_ncbi.sh` | — |
| `ncbi_virus/all_genomes.fasta` | `01_download_ncbi.sh` (copied from the unzipped package) | `02_prefilter_split.sh` |
| `ncbi_virus/all/ncbi_dataset/data/data_report.jsonl` | `01_download_ncbi.sh` (part of the NCBI package) | `scripts/preprocessing/05_augment_nextclade.py` |
| `ncbi_virus/all_genomes_len28500_31000.fasta` (or the relaxed `..._len25000_32000.fasta` fallback) | `02_prefilter_split.sh` | `02_prefilter_split.sh` itself (sharding input) |
| `ncbi_virus/shards/*.fasta`, `ncbi_virus/shards/shard_list.txt` | `02_prefilter_split.sh` | `cluster/slurm/preprocessing/03_nextclade_array.sh` (via `submit_nextclade_pipeline.sh`) |
| `nextclade/all_parts/<shard>/nextclade.tsv`, `.../nextclade.cds_translation.S.fasta` | `03_nextclade_array.sh` (one subdir per shard) | `04_merge_nextclade.sh` |
| `nextclade/all/nextclade.tsv` | `04_merge_nextclade.sh` | `scripts/preprocessing/05_augment_nextclade.py` |
| `nextclade/all/gene_spike.fasta` | `04_merge_nextclade.sh` | `scripts/preprocessing/06_filter_metadata.py` |
| `nextclade/all/nextclade_augmented.tsv` | `scripts/preprocessing/05_augment_nextclade.py` | `scripts/preprocessing/06_filter_metadata.py` |

From step 06 onward, outputs move to `data/processed/` — see `data/processed/README.md`.

Regenerate by running `cluster/slurm/preprocessing/01` through `05` in order (see the
top-level [README.md](../../README.md), "Data preprocessing").
